QuestInfo.name: Help Me Find My Glasses
QuestInfo.0: Apparently there's someone on the harbor, in trouble. He says he's lost something that's practically like a body part of his...
QuestInfo.1: Having lost his glasses, Abel is unable to see anything. Let me help Abel find his glasses in the bushes near the #bwatchtower#k, located on the east end of The Nautilus harbor where the seagulls have gathered. And remember, #bAbel's glasses#k have horn-rimmed frames!                                          \n\n#i4031853##t4031853# #b#c4031853##k / 1
QuestInfo.2: Oh. Abel seems so happy to have his glasses back. But now that he's got his glasses back, he seems like such a different person. Do those glasses have some kind of power?

item.0: My glasses are horn-rimmed. Please find them for me.

0.0: My glasses... my glasses...\n\r#L0##b Is something wrong? Did you drop something on the ground?#k#l
0.1: Ahhh, please don't come near me! My glasses might have been dropped somewhere, and you don't want to step on them! Are my glasses around there? A black horn-rimmed pair of glasses...\n\r#L0##b No, I don't see any glasses around here...#k#l
0.2: Man... I told Bart so many times not to take my glasses. He likes shiny objects, so he'd take them while I am asleep... and each time that happens, the seagulls seem to take them from him. I am legally blind without them, so... can you go up to the Observatory Tower and find my glasses?

yes.0: Thank you so much. My glasses are like another pair of my eyes. Without them, I can't see anything. Like I said, I am legally blind without them. I can't even recognize your face. It's just a blur to me.
yes.1: Mine are a black, horn-rimmed glasses. My eyes are so bad without them that I can't see anything in front of me, so please find them!
yes.2: You can find the #bObservatory Tower#k by #bheading right all the way#k. You'll see Bart and those seagulls in flocks, so it won't be hard for you to find my #bglasses#k. Please bring them back to me!

no.0: Don't you find me even a bit sad? You must be one cold-hearted person.
